items.title: Normality away from the special fibre after completion forces the normalization to be finite and compatible with completion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the complement of the special fibre in the base change along a completion is normal, then the normalization of the source is finite and its base change recovers the normalization of the base change (statement lines 3189-3197). The proof (proof lines 3199-3233) descends normality along the faithfully flat completion, uses finiteness of normalization over the Nagata completion together with formal glueing to produce a finite morphism over the source, and identifies it with the normalization after checking normality at the special fibre. H3: a descent and glueing argument with three inputs, written out in full.
